Therefore, CIS was formed in [[24 BBY]]. Additionally, because the ratification of the [[Geonosian accord]] first appeared in ''Attack of the Clones'', the events of which are dated to 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] by ''Timelines'', the accord must have been ratified in 22 BBY. *22 BBY {{C|official founding}} |fragmented= |reorganized=[[19 BBY]], {{c|[[Separatist Reintegration Day|reinregrated]] into the [[Galactic Empire]] and several [[Separatist holdouts|holdouts]] established}}''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] |dissolved=19 BBY''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' |restored=[[5 ABY]],According to ''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'', [[Mon Mothma]] was worried about the rise of the New Separatist Union [[Standard week|weeks]] before the [[Battle of Jakku]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates that battle to [[5 ABY]], the New Separatist Union must have been formed by that [[Standard year|year]]. as the [[New Separatist Union]] |affiliation=[[Sith]] {{C|secretly}}{{Film|II}} }} {{Quote|It is an honor to stand before you, for you represent the freedom and the future of our galaxy. The once-great Republic and Jedi Order have become victims of their own ambitions, and the Supreme Chancellor is no more than a pawn of corporate monopolies. As a people you called out for change, you called out for leadership, and I humbly answered that call. Together we challenged the system. We asked for equality. And how were we met? With war! The Jedi secret army of clones was revealed, and their treachery was far greater than we could have imagined! Countless living beings—these clones the Jedi created—have been sent to their deaths, while we sacrifice mainly droids. Our soldiers of flesh and blood are willing participants! They are your fathers and sons, mothers and daughters, who fight not because they were grown and designed to do so, but because they know in their hearts that they are fighting for a just and noble cause!|Count Dooku|''[[Dark Disciple]]''}} The '''Confederacy of Independent Systems''', abbreviated to '''CIS''', and otherwise known as the '''Separatist Alliance''', the '''Separatist State''', the '''Separatist Confederacy''', the '''Separatist coalition''', or simply referred to as the '''Separatists''', was a [[confederacy|confederation]] with limited recognition of outlying [[star system]]s in [[the galaxy]] that had declared independence from the [[Galactic Republic]] and had its [[capital]] on the [[planet]] [[Raxus Secundus]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]. Secession could be traced back to the [[Raxus Address]] by former [[Jedi Master]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]] of [[Serenno]], from a belief of excessive taxation and corruption within the [[Galactic Senate]], as well as a general feeling of dissatisfaction towards the neglect by the Republic-centric [[Core Worlds]]. Furthermore, the Confederacy was secretly [[Geonosian accord|supported]] by several major [[Galaxy|galactic]] corporations which formed the executive [[Executive Separatist Council|council]], while a [[Separatist Senate|parliament]] of [[senator]]s became its civilian legislature. Thousands of disgruntled star systems seceded from the Republic and joined together in the newly-created Confederacy of Independent Systems, born from a galaxy-wide secessionist movement orchestrated by the [[Count of Serenno]] Dooku. By 24 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], it had become a [[Separatist Crisis|political crisis]] which led to escalating tensions between the Republic and the rising Confederacy. Many within the Confederacy, including its senators, had no desire in fighting their adversaries, as they sought to be free of what they saw as the corruption and tyranny of the Republic. This reluctance stemmed from Count Dooku's portrayal of the Confederacy of Independent Systems as a cure for the Republic's corruption. a narrative that masked a grim reality. In truth, the movement was steered by the same corporate titans who had already crippled the Galactic Senate. Using their Executive Council, these CEOs held senators' home systems hostage by threatening to cut off life-sustaining supplies if they voted against their interests. This lethal intimidation left the Senate huddled in fear and unable to cast a single decisive vote, creating the very gridlock that Separatist leaders then cited as "proof" of Republic incompetence to justify their secession. The Confederacy was supported by the [[Trade Federation]], led by [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]]; the [[Stalgasin hive]], led by [[Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser]]; the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], headed by [[Chairman]] [[San Hill]]; the [[Techno Union]], led by [[Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor]]; the [[Commerce Guild]], led by [[Presidente]] [[Shu Mai]]; the [[Corporate Alliance]], led by [[Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente]]; and the [[Retail Caucus]]. However, in [[22 BBY]], both governments and their [[Confederacy military|respective]] [[Republic Military|military]] forces became enmeshed in the pan-galactic [[Clone Wars]], the first major conflict in a [[millennium]], after the conflict [[First Battle of Geonosis|exploded into being]] on the Confederacy's first capital world, [[Geonosis]]. In the following three [[Standard year|years]] of the war, which had raged across the entire galaxy on several fronts, the Confederacy made rapid attempts to cease the Republic's influence. However, unknown to most of the galaxy or either side, the war was orchestrated by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]] as part of a [[Grand Plan|long-percolating plot]] to destroy the [[Jedi Order]], corrupt the Republic from within and transform it into a reincarnated [[Sith Empire]] with himself as its [[Emperor]]. As such, Sidious led both the Confederacy through Dooku as his [[Sith Master]], and the Republic himself as the public persona of [[Supreme Chancellor]] Sheev Palpatine. Additionally, both [[Sith Lord]]s played a crucial role in establishing [[Order 66|Clone Protocol 66]], which was originally requested by the late Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas]] to the [[Kaminoan]]s in [[33 BBY]] as part of the clone programming, acting as a safeguard against rogue [[Jedi]] and reducing aggression among [[clone trooper]]s by introducing [[behavioral modification biochip]]s to their [[brain]]s. However, Sifo-Dyas' former friend Dooku [[Mission to Felucia (Sifo-Dyas)|orchestrated his death]] and Sifo-Dyas' project was taken over by the Sith [[32 BBY|one year later]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo]]. Instead, protocol 66 made the clones see the Jedi as [[Treason|traitors]] of the Republic, leading to their imminent [[Death|elimination]] when Sidious would order it. The command would be issued after a [[Duel in Palpatine's office|supposed attempt to Palpatine's life at his office]] in [[19 BBY]], in which [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] pledged his allegiance to Darth Sidious and became [[Darth]] Vader, deceiving both parties in the process. By the third year of the war, the Confederacy had suffered several major defeats in the [[Outer Rim Sieges]] as the conflict began to approach its end, while losing many [[starship]]s in the decisive [[Battle of Coruscant]], which also resulted in the [[death]] of Dooku. In the [[Standard day|days]] following their defeat at [[Coruscant]], [[General]] [[Grievous]] was [[Battle of Utapau|neutralized]] on the planet [[Utapau]], leading to the collapse of the Separatist leadership, and the fighting effectively came to an end. Following both the [[Great Jedi Purge|Jedi's demise]] and [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise of the]] [[Galactic Empire]], [[Viceroy]] Nute Gunray and the other surviving leaders gathered on the planet [[Mustafar]] with hopes of securing peace with the newly rising Empire ruled by [[Galactic Emperor]] Sheev Palpatine. However, he sent his new apprentice Darth Vader to [[Mission to Mustafar|wipe out]] the remaining Separatist leadership and deactivate their [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]]. With the end of the Clone Wars, the newly-formed Galactic Empire, as the successor to the Old Republic, [[Separatist Reintegration Day|reintegrated]] former Separatists worlds into the Empire. Nonetheless, several [[Separatist holdouts]] still survived in opposition to Imperial power. Despite the suppression of many of these remnants as Imperial rule solidified and expanded, an idealized view of the Separatist cause persisted during the [[Imperial Era]] amongst its remaining supporters, with some still holding secessionist tendencies even into the [[New Republic Era]]. ==History== ===Early foundations=== {{Quote|The Republic is not what it once was.|Senator Palpatine of Naboo on the declining state of the Senate and Republic|{{Film|I}}}} [[File:ZodKneelsBeforeAmidala-TPMHD.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Under the leadership of ineffective Chancellors like Finis Valorum, the Galactic Republic became increasingly corrupt, prompting the rise of secessionist ideologies.]] For a [[millennium]], [[the galaxy]] had been overseen by the [[Galactic Republic]] from the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] in the [[Core Worlds]], and was in turn governed by the [[Galactic Senate]], which was led by an elected [[Supreme Chancellor]]. With assistance from the [[Jedi Order]], who acted as peacekeepers, the Republic and thereby the [[galaxy]] had not endured conflict for an entire millennium. However, the government began to become both weak and corrupt. [[File:DookuWinduEnGarde-Choices.png|thumb|right|250px|Often when anti-Republic groups arose, the Galactic Senate of the Republic would deploy members of the Jedi Order to deal with them, with some like Jedi Master Dooku witnessing the hypocrisy of the Republic in the process.]] During this era of peace, heightening [[Politics|political]] tensions arose within the Republic a [[Standard decade|decade]] before the [[Clone Wars]]. For example, when a group of [[Halcyon usurpers|usurpers]] on the planet [[Halcyon (planet)|Halcyon]] became discontent with the world's membership and wanted their world to be able to manage its own affairs. They kidnapped several members of Halcyon's planetary leadership and held them in a remote fortress where they prepared for assault while attempting negotiation with their hostages. Internal negotiations failed and led the Senate to eventually [[Mission to Halcyon|authorize]] the [[Jedi]] Order to intervene on Halcyon as mediators and enforcers if necessary. By [[28 BBY]],The main story of ''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' takes place 4 [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places in [[32 BBY]]. there was a growing number of senators in the Galactic Senate who valued loyalty to the planet they represented over loyalty to the Republic as a whole. These senators argued it was impossible to truly remain objective when discussing the entire galaxy.''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' [[File:InvasionOfNaboo.png|thumb|left|250px|The Trade Federation's Invasion of Naboo and the Republic's subsequent lack of aide to Naboo exposed the extent of corruption within the Republic's Senate.]] The [[Invasion of Naboo|Invasion]] of [[Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation]] exposed the unwillingness and inability of the Senate to resolve the crisis, which ended only after the [[Gungan]]s and [[Royal House of Naboo]] united and forcibly [[Battle of Naboo|ended]] the occupation. This lack of action was a result of [[Standard year|years]] of corrupt and ineffectual governance by the Republic that had became mired in bureaucracy and layers upon layers of increasingly complex legal precedents, treaties, and obligations. The commerce guilds and trading corporations had also become disillusioned after laws were passed that would introduce taxes affecting all significant trade routes, implemented such that they would have the greatest impact on the poorer outlying [[star system]]s. These worlds were often forced into accepting one-sided deals and refused military protection, as the Republic continued to prioritize honoring centuries old agreements predating the admission of outlying planets. [[File:CountDookuCorruptedPolitician-AoN.png|thumb|right|250px|After leaving the Jedi Order due to the Republic's corruption, Dooku would reclaim his birthright as Count of his homeworld Serreno, using his newfound riches to finance a growing Separatist movement against the Republic, though he himself would eventually become a pawn of the Sith.]] Compounding this, the outlying systems and Rimward trade routes were plagued by pirates, hijackers and slavers. Due to the refusal of the Republic to create a military to police those sectors, the [[Judicial Department]] was completely overwhelmed, and could not adequately protect either the worlds along those trade routes, or the cargo vessels that traversed them. This forced outlying systems to begin creating their own militias to deal with the pirates, with the [[Outland Regions Security Force]] being foremost among them. Gridlock in the senate grew, as the number of votes needed to pass any type of legislation turned it increasingly into a place where [[senator]]s bartered favors, earmarks, and votes for personal power without regard for their constituencies or the greater good of the Republic. Some began to believe that any attempt at change would require radical thinking and extreme actions, leading to discussions of secession from the Republic.{{TCW|The Lost One}} ===Secession from the Republic=== {{Quote|I am committed to the idea of a galaxy ruled by an enlightened leader, with laws that apply universally—not one set for the Core Worlds, another for the Outer Rim worlds."
"An autocracy, guided by the count of Serenno."
"I am ambitious, but not to that degree.|Count Dooku and Governor Wilhuff Tarkin of Eriadu, during their final dinner together before the onset of the Clone Wars|}} [[File:CountDooku-WordsofTruth.png|thumb|left|200px|A pamphlet for [[Reena University]] highlighting Dooku's [[Independent Movement for Self-Determination]], by [[Ansibella Dellu]].]] The first declaration of secession could be traced back to the [[Raxus Address]] delivered by [[Count]] [[Dooku]], a former [[Jedi Master]] who had personally witnessed signs of discontent with the Republic and its corruption{{TOTJ|Justice (episode)}}{{TOTJ|Choices}} before joining the [[Sith]] in the hope of creating change,{{TOTJ|The Sith Lord}} only to become immersed in the dark side and corrupted.,{{TBB|Spoils of War}}{{TBB|Ruins of War}} In his address, which he delivered via a commandeered HoloNet-relay station in the [[Raxus system]], the [[count]] denounced the Galactic Republic as a futile enterprise that was hopelessly burdened by corruption and favoritism toward the [[Core Worlds]]. Following the address, Dooku founded the Confederacy of Independent Systems and began the [[Separatist Crisis]]. Some believed he was merely one step ahead of Republic assassins after his speech. The fallen Jedi Master's words of inflammatory rhetoric would find receptive audiences among young intellectuals in [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid]] and [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]] universities. Both charismatic and exuding confidence, Dooku's message rallied thousands of individuals by recounting decades of experience within the Republic government and publicizing its hypocrisies, corruption and ineffectiveness.''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'' Dooku's rebellious message mesmerized young psyches and spurred them into political activism. As the galactic crisis grew more and more heated, Dooku's appearances grew uncommon, and were announced with much shorter notice, often spurning violence on polarized worlds. Thousands of disgruntled star systems ultimately seceded from the Republic and fully embraced the newly-created Confederacy of Independent Systems' fiery message of resistance. The idea that the Republic was distant, dispassionate, corrupt, and unworthy of membership ultimately marshaled disgruntled systems into a new galactic government. The agrarian world of [[Ukio]] found itself questioning what value it reciprocated for being the breadbasket of the Core Worlds, and after citing a litany of neglect, senatorial representatives of the [[Abrion sector]] tendered their articles of secession along with other worlds in the galaxy's hinterlands. The [[Hassarian]] people joined the Confederacy at some point.''[[Tales from the Rancor Pit]]'' [[File:2000_Senators_propaganda.png|thumb|right|200px|With the outbreak of the Separatist Crisis, the CIS would begin creating propaganda against the Republic.]] The Confederacy also sought to gain prosperous [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] world of [[Eriadu]]: with its location at the confluence of the [[Hydian Way]] and [[Rimma Trade Route]], Dooku needed Eriadu's allegiance to control the [[Greater Seswenna]] and effectively collapse the Core back onto itself, undoing millennia of galactic exploration, conquest, and colonization. After negotiations and attending dinners with Eriadu's then-[[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], the attempt to claim Eriadu's loyalty would fail, as Tarkin refused, believing that an ineffective yet unified galaxy was better than a fractured one.{{TCW|Supply Lines}} Thanks to Tarkin and several other holdouts, Dooku was unable to have the economic monopoly needed to force the Republic into negotiations. As a legislative branch, the Confederacy established a [[Separatist Senate]] under Dooku. The Republic, meanwhile, declared it illegal for its officials to hold formal talks with the Confederacy through the [[Republic Senate non-communication law]]''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' to avoid making the Confederacy seem legitimate. [[File:JourneysBeginnings-SepCouncil.png|thumb|left|300px|Dooku and the Separatist Council prior to the Clone Wars.]] With the [[Separatist Crisis]] intensifying as more systems pledged loyalty to the Dooku separatist-government across the galaxy, causing uncertainty and fears that the Republic would be split into two, the Senate of the Republic moved towards the passage of the [[Military Creation Act]], which would establish centralized armed forces to protect the thousand-year-old democracy for the first time. Meanwhile, Dooku had promised the [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] that he would assassinate Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of Naboo if he signed Dooku's treaty. The Viceroy accepted the offer, and Dooku dispatched [[Jango Fett]] to carry out Amidala's assassination. [[File:NabooCruiserGoBoom-AOTC.png|thumb|right|250px|Count Dooku would contract Jango Fett to assassinate Senator Padmé Amidala in order to carry favor with Nute Gunray of the Trade Federation, though the attempts would fail.]] Despite the failure of Fett's [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|mission]], Dooku was able to persuade the Trade Federation, the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], the [[Techno Union]], the [[Commerce Guild]], and the [[Corporate Alliance]] to all sign a [[Geonosian accord|treaty]] on the Confederate capital planet [[Geonosis]] and join together as the [[Executive Separatist Council]]. After pursuing Fett to Geonosis, Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] discovered Dooku's plot, and also learned that it was Gunray who ordered the assassination of Amidala. He was captured shortly thereafter and imprisoned by Dooku, but not before sending a message to the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] relating what he had discovered. Meanwhile, tensions between the Republic and the seccessionist movement peaked after the Republic learned of the size and significance of its army of [[battle droid]]s, motivating the Senate to grant emergency powers to the Supreme Chancellor of the Republic, a position that was then occupied by [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], the alter ego of [[Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious. [[File:GeonosisJediDieDeflectingShots.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi would be overwhelmed by the Separatist Droid Army on Geonosis, only to be rescued by the Republic's clone army.]] During the attempted execution of Obi-Wan Kenobi, [[Anakin Skywalker]], and Senator Amidala on Geonosis, a team of two hundred Jedi were sent to rescue the trio. The Jedi were attacked by a host of battle droids during the attempt, and were corralled into an arena. With the battle turning against the Jedi, Dooku gave the remaining Jedi forces a chance to lay down their arms, a choice which [[Mace Windu]] declined. In the next few moments, several [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] arrived over the arena, and [[First Battle of Geonosis|engaged]] [[Separatist Droid Army|droid forces]] on the planet's surface, starting the deadly Clone Wars. ===The Clone Wars=== ====Beginning the war==== {{Quote|Day by day, ''grow'', the Separatists' numbers do. Their reach extends farther and farther to the Outer Rim.''"
"''Power flows in ''concentric circles''. Establish a foothold in the ''Outer Rim'' before moving inward toward the ''capital''.|Jedi Masters Yoda and Mace Windu, on the CIS war strategy|[[Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu 1|''Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu'' 1]]}} [[File:Homing_Spider_Droid.png|thumb|right|300px|The Separatist Droid Army during the Battle of Geonosis.]] The arrival of the clones sparked a full-scale battle on Geonosis, with both sides taking heavy losses. Eventually however, the clone army began to gain the upper hand. This forced Poggle to order his soldiers to retreat and hide, but before he joined them, he turned over [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Ultimate Weapon]]—a secret project he had been contracted to build by the Separatists—to Count Dooku. As the battle raged on, Kenobi and Skywalker caught up to Dooku and tried to prevent his escape by engaging in a lightsaber duel, however they were defeated by Dooku with relative ease. [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] came to their rescue and engaged Dooku in a lightsaber battle. After realizing that he was outmatched by Yoda, Dooku fled Geonosis and the Separatist leadership retreated. Though they had suffered a defeat in battle, the goal of the [[Sith]] had been fulfilled; the Clone Wars had begun. [[File:B2sbdGeonosis-AOTC.png|thumb|left|250px|Throughout the Separatist Crisis, the CIS built up a massive droid army on Geonosis with the support of corporate backers in the Separatist Council.]] Shortly after[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] the CIS retreated from and vacated Geonosis,''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' the Separatists began to seize control of the major [[Hyperspace route|hyperspace lanes]], separating the Republic from its army, and expand into the Outer Rim. The Separatists also established the planet [[Raxus Secundus]] as their new capital world. The Clone Wars engulfed the galaxy incredibly fast. The speed at which the fighting spread convinced [[Dormé]], a [[handmaiden]] to Senator Amidala, that the Confederacy had moved its forces out before the formal beginning of war against the Republic. Per her reasoning, the CIS had every reason to assume the events on Geonosis would be a victory and, thus, spread out its military for a big attack. Whenever the signal to deploy was given, the CIS military would reveal itself and finish the war just as it began.''[[Queen's Hope]]'' Instead, the arrival of the Grand Army of the Republic on Geonosis and its deployment across the galaxy complicated matters. [[File:CloneTrooperInfantry-SWL2024update.png|thumb|right|250px|The sudden deployment of the clone army in the First Battle of Geonosis would force the CIS to retreat from the planet, though the bulk of their droid army would escape to wreck havoc on the Republic in the ensuing Clone Wars.]] Jedi Master Windu suspected the Confederacy's expansion into the Rim was part of a march to the Core. To Windu, it was a sign of how power followed in concentric circles: the growing Separatist forces would establish a foothold in the Rim before moving inward, continuing to advance until they reached Coruscant itself. Furthermore, Separatist war strategy accounted for the fact that not every battle would be a CIS victory. Instead, the Separatists believed the conflict would become too costly for the Republic at a certain point. ====Attacks and defenses==== [[File:CorvairVultures-AORAnakin1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Immediatly following Geonosis, the galaxy would erupt into war between the CIS and the Republic.]] At some point, the Confederacy launched an [[attack on Phindar]]. [[Quermia]] remained loyal to the Republic but found itself surrounded by Separatist space, resulting in the Confederacy beginning a harsh [[Blockade of Quermia|blockade]] of the planet.''[[Savage Spirits]]'' With the outbreak of hostilities, many worlds either declared openly for the Separatists or declared neutrality, declining to support either side. Some of the neutral worlds banded together into a loose alliance, The [[Council of Neutral Systems]],{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}} which also worked to establish mutual negotiation as an advisory group,{{TCW|A Friend in Need}} not a breakaway government. Both sides negotiated with the neutral worlds, with the Republic trying to bring worlds back into the fold willingly if they had not declared for the Separatists due to fears that taking action against ostensibly non-hostile worlds would only increase sympathy for the separatist cause. [[File:Battle_of_Christophsis_2.png|thumb|right|300px|Armored Assault Tanks advance through Crystal City on Christophsis.]] The war proceeded on many fronts. A [[Whorm Loathsom's army|force]] led by [[Asajj Ventress]] and [[General]] [[Whorm Loathsom]] succeeded in [[Battle of Christophsis|capturing]] [[Christophsis]]. After taking the planet, they targeted a small relief-force led by Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]],{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}} but the Confederate occupation was eventually defeated by [[Jedi General]]s [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Skywalker's [[Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], and their [[clone trooper]]s. Later on [[Teth]] in [[Wild Space]], the Separatists hatched a plot to deny the Jedi the alliance with the [[Hutt Clan]] that they so desperately needed and to establish an alliance with the Hutts themselves. Republic forces [[Battle of Teth|attempted]] to save [[Rotta]], the infant son of [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]], from the Confederacy, who planned to [[Death|kill]] the Huttlet and lay the blame on the Jedi Order. However, Skywalker and Tano effected a rescue of the Huttlet from Teth, and return him to [[Tatooine]], thus gaining the support of the Hutts for the Republic. [[File:Ryloth_Battle_SL.png|thumb|left|250px|CIS forces under Wat Tambor swiftly eliminated all Republic forces on Ryloth, leaving the local Twi'lek resistance fighters to fend for themselves until Republic reinforcements could arrive later in the war.]] After the annihilation of the Republic [[Outer Rim garrison|garrison]], [[Ryloth]] was occupied and [[Ryloth blockade|blockaded]] by the Separatist Droid Army. The army was led by [[Emir]] [[Wat Tambor]], who oversaw the occupation from the city of [[Lessu City|Lessu]]. During the occupation, much of Ryloth was pillaged by the droid army on orders from the Emir. CIS forces were [[Battle of Ryloth|repeatedly]] attacked by a [[Twi'lek Resistance|group]] of [[Twi'lek]] freedom-fighters led by [[Cham Syndulla]], but suffered minimal losses. Eventually, the Republic Army assembled a force to liberate the planet, a goal they accomplished after much heavy fighting. The Republic captured Tambor, but his tactical droid escaped with many of the valuables he had looted from the Twi'leks.{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}} [[File:Malevolence-TCWIV.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Malevolence'' superweapon.]] However, soon the Confederacy would reveal during the [[Malevolence Campaign|''Malevolence'' Campaign]]{{Databank|battle-droid|Battle Droid}} its massive new [[superweapon]] known only as the ''[[Malevolence]]'', a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|''Subjugator''-class]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' [[heavy cruiser]],{{Databank|malevolence|''Malevolence''}} that was commanded by [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Commander]] General [[Grievous]]. It worked by firing a powerful [[ion cannon]] to disable enemy ships before destroying them with a barrage of more-conventional cannonfire. The ship gained the attention of the Republic after destroying the [[Plo Koon's fleet|fleet]] of Jedi General [[Plo Koon]] in the [[Battle of Abregado]]. Koon was marooned in an [[escape pod]], and rescued by General Skywalker. The Separatist Head of State then ordered Grievous to use the ship to attack an unarmed Republic [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center|medical center]] near the [[Ryndellia system]]. Having been alerted to the impending [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula|attack]], the Republic dispatched a [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's taskforce|fleet]] to rescue the medical station. After a fierce fight, the ship was finally destroyed when Skywalker tampered with the ship's navicomputer and crashed it into a nearby [[Dead Moon of Antar|moon]].{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}} [[File:Bomb_on_Malastare_droid_forces.png|thumb|left|300px|The Grand Army of the Republic detonates a prototype Electro-proton bomb on Malastare.]] The Confederacy would attempt to gain [[Malastare]], which was of strategic importance to both the Republic and the Separatist forces, due to the abundance of natural resources on the planet. The Republic was keen to sign a [[Treaty of Malastare|treaty]] with the Malastare leadership – however, their plans were put on hold while the Separatist Droid Army [[Battle of Malastare|invaded]] the planet. Due to the low number of military forces on the planet, the Republic forces were quickly overwhelmed and, in the face of certain defeat, authorized the use of an experimental [[Electro-proton bomb]]. The leaders of Malastare then proceeded to sign the treaty with the Republic.{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}} However, a setback occurred when the plan by the InterGalactic Banking Clan and the Separatists to build massive new [[Droid factory|droid foundries]] on Geonosis was discovered by the Galactic Republic,{{TCW|Senate Spy}} who launched a second major planetary [[Second Battle of Geonosis|invasion]] of Geonosis to shut down the foundries that [[Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser]] had built there.{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}} [[File:2nd_Battle_of_Geonosis.png|thumb|right|300px|The CIS would covertly regain control of Geonosis in 21 BBY, prompting a second Republic invasion]] After their [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia|discovery]] on [[Cato Neimoidia]], the Republic dispatched a massive detachment of clones to retake Geonosis and stop the production of battle droids. Although the droid foundries had been destroyed, Poggle remained at large for a time, until he was captured in the catacombs underneath [[Progate Temple]].{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}} ====Setbacks==== [[File:VizslaArmy.png|thumb|left|250px|Count Dooku would back the Mandalorian terrorists of Death Watch, hoping to bring the military potential of Mandalore into the CIS]] In order to gain much-needed support for their attempt at taking over [[Mandalore]], the Death Watch briefly allied themselves with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. His actions, in addition to false rumors, led many in the Republic to believe that [[Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze]], the leader of the New Mandalorian government and head of the Council of Neutral Systems, was training a Mandalorian army for the Separatists.{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}} [[File:Kenobi_vs_Vizsla.jpg|thumb|right|250px|After a Death Watch warrior working for the CIS was captured by the Republic, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi was dispatched by the Jedi Council to investigate, leading to a confrontation with Death Watch's leader, Pre Vizsla.]] The Jedi Council dispatched Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi to Mandalore to meet with Satine and investigate the rumors. During these events the leader of death watch — [[Pre Vizsla]] — communicated with [[Count of Serenno|Count]] Dooku who revealed his strategy. [[File:Vizsla-Dooku-argue.png|thumb|left|250px|The alliance between Death Watch and the CIS would fall apart due to the actions of Mandalorian Dutchess Satine Kryze and Obi-Wan Kenobi.]] When Satine journeyed to Coruscant, Death Watch made a [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet|second attempt on her life]]. After being shown the new evidence, the Republic Senate revoked its order to send peacekeepers to Mandalore. [[File:GrievousVentress-KaminoARC.png|thumb|right|300px|General Grievous and Dark Acolyte Asajj Ventress, two of Count Dooku's primary enforcers, would launch a joint assault on the Republic's cloning facilities on Kamino.]] Following the destruction of a Republic monitoring station, the Separatist army, led by General Grievous and Asajj Ventress, begin a daring [[Battle of Kamino|invasion]] of the cloning world of Kamino. As part of the conspiracy, the daughters of the Pantoran [[Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida|Papanoida]] were [[Kidnapping of the Papanoida daughters|kidnapped]] and held hostage on the main ship of the Separatist-blockade. Following a daring rescue by Ahsoka Tano and Pantoran Senator [[Riyo Chuchi]], the conspiracy was uncovered, and the Trade Federation was forced to remove its blockade.{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}} [[File:MinaBonteriSpeaks-HOBS.png|thumb|left|250px|With the support of Senator Padmé Amidala, CIS Senator Mina Bonteri would successfully push for a peace treaty with the Republic, though Count Dooku would sabotage the peace talks and later cause the assassination of Bonteri herself, allowing the war to continue.]] Following a secret meeting between Padmé Amidala and [[Mina Bonteri]], the [[Separatist Senate]] approved the start of peace talks between the Separatists and the Republic. During the escape, Piell was killed but the vital information was passed onto Tano. Following a number of challenges, the team managed to escape the prison with the coordinates and most of the former prisoners.{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}} Following the defeat of the Republic during the [[First Battle of Felucia]], the Republic army launched a [[Second Battle of Felucia|second invasion]] attempt. During the ensuing battle, the Quarren came to the realization that the Separatists were only interested in capturing Mon Cala for themselves. With this in mind, they turned on the Separatist forces and defeated them.{{TCW|Prisoners}} [[File:Rish_Loo_on_a_separatist_command_center_on_Naboo.png|thumb|right|250px|Conspiring with the CIS, Minister Rish Loo attempted to manipulate the Gungan Grand Army into launching a joint attack on Naboo with General Grievous.]] Dooku later conspired with Grievous and [[Minister]] [[Rish Loo]] to launch another [[Skirmish on Naboo|invasion]] of Naboo, a plot that would involve turning the Gungans against the humans there. The Gungan army surrounded Grievous and told him to surrender.{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}} [[File:GrievousCaptured-SW.png|thumb|left|250px|After Rish Loo's plot was exposed by Jar Jar Binks, the Gungan Grand Army turned on the CIS, capturing Grievous, though the cyborg general would be freed in a prison transfer shortly afterwords.]] Grievous replied by drawing two lightsabers, and killing several Gungan warriors. Just before he died, Tarpals drove his spear all the way through Grievous, allowing the rest of the Gungan warriors to disable Grievous with boombas. [[File:Stub-Umbara.png|thumb|right|250px|Umbara's decision to join the CIS would lead to a brutal Republic invasion of the planet, with the Umbarans suffering heavy casualties against the Republic.]] After the assassination of senator [[Mee Deechi]] at the hands of [[Lolo Purs]],{{TCW|Senate Murders}} the planet [[Umbara]] seceded from the Galactic Republic and joined the Confederacy, pledging the [[Umbaran Militia]] and its advanced technology to the cause. Despite their efforts and Jedi General [[Pong Krell]]'s treason against the Republic, Umbara successfully became part of the Republic again.{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}} [[File:DookuDnarArriveOnKiros-Kidnapped.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The CIS would forge an alliance with the reemerging Zygerrian Slave Empire to forcefully take control of the planet Kiros, enslaving the local Togruta colonists.]] The Confederacy, meanwhile, had formed an alliance with [[Miraj Scintel|Queen Miraj Scintel]], leader of the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]]. Seeing his opportunity, Skywalker freed Tano, and carried the Queen onto a slave-ship, upon which he escaped.{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}} [[File:CT-4860-Piloting.png|thumb|right|250px|Imediantly following their Queen's death at Dooku's hand, Republic forces would assault the Zygerrian's slave processing facility on Kadavo, rescuing the imprisoned Togruta and causing the collapse of their slave empire.]] Following Skywalker's escape, the Queen, before perishing, revealed to him the location of the processing facility where Kenobi and the missing Togruta-colonists were being held, [[Kadavo]]. Soon after their arrival, Republic [[Plo Koon's second fleet|reinforcements]] arrived, and the facility's defenses were soon disabled. With no hope of escape, [[Keeper]] [[Agruss]] attempted to kill the colonists by dropping them into a volcanic pit. However, his plan was foiled when Tano devised a plan to rescue the colonists, and he was killed. With the successful rescue of Kenobi and the colonists, the Jedi departed the facility, and destroyed it.{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}} [[File:Peace_conference.png|thumb|left|250px|Senators from both the Republic and CIS met on the neutral planet Mandalore, hoping to once again bring about a peaceful resolution to the war, though the negotiations would fall apart following an incident triggered by Lux Bonteri, Mina Bonteri's son.]] At the height of the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems held a peace conference with the Galactic Republic on the neutral planet Mandalore between representatives of both governments in an effort to end the pan-galactic conflict. This led young Bonteri to soon afterward be escorted out by Separatist commando-droids, allowing the discussion to continue. [[File:OnderonRoyalGuard-FR.png|thumb|right|250px|The CIS backed Sanjay Rash's coup to become King of Onderon, allowing the planet to fall under CIS control, which was opposed by a local insurrection to reinstate the former King Ramsis Dendup.]] With Onderon's secession from the Galactic Republic at the beginning of the Clone Wars having been instigated{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}} by a [[Invasion of Onderon|Separatist coup]],{{EncyclopediaCite|The Clone Wars}} King [[Sanjay Rash]] found his regime, backed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, challenged by a group of [[Onderon rebels|rebels]] [[Onderonian Civil War|organized]] by the young insurgents [[Steela Gerrera|Steela]] and [[Saw Gerrera]]. Midway through the training, the camp was attacked, and the lessons escalated into actual combat when a battle droid-squadron attempted to exterminate the rebels; however, the newly-trained rebels eliminated the enemy droid-squad. [[File:Tandin_holds_Rash_at_lance_point_Onderon.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Despite gaining additional battle droids from the CIS, King Rash would lose more of the people's support in favor of the growing insurrection, with even the Royal Guard of Onderon turning against him.]] The rebels then infiltrated the Separatist-occupied capital [[Iziz]], conducting strikes on droid patrols throughout the city. Count Dooku sent King Rash reinforcements under the command of the [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] General [[Kalani]].{{TCW|Front Runners}} After the rebels attempted and failed to free the deposed King Dendup, King Rash ordered his public execution. As Rash angrily protested, Kalani shot the deluded king, killing him.{{TCW|Tipping Points}} [[File:RenownBlownToBits-PoNR.png|thumb|left|250px|A CIS Super Tactical Droid used a captured Republic star destroyer full of volatile rydonium to nearly destroy a large portion of Republic leadership in the Carida Incident, though the attack would be sabotaged by a single Republic astromech droid, R2-D2.]] The [[Carida Incident]] was the result of a mission undertaken by the Confederacy of Independent Systems who sabotaged the ''[[Renown]]'', a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], by loading it with rhydonium canisters with the intention of ramming it into the [[Valor (space station)|''Valor'' space station]], the site of a Republic strategy conference. With their momentum lost, the Republic had no option other than to withdraw. However, before Tup could be delivered to the Confederacy for study, he was recaptured by Anakin Skywalker and the Republic on the [[Kraken's Maxillipede shuttle|ongoing]] [[Maxillipede shuttle|shuttle]], with [[Kraken]] killed in the raid, and made it to Kamino.{{TCW|The Unknown}} [[File:DiplomaticCorps-CotH.png|thumb|left|250px|CIS forces under Dooku's direct command would launch a brutal invasion of the Banking Clan capital on Scipio.]] Meanwhile, one the Confederacy's backers, the Banking Clan, which was previously deregulated, was on the verge of collapse. [[File:Dathomir_Disciple.jpg|thumb|left|250px|After Count Dooku carried out a genocide on Mahranee, the Jedi Council would dispatch Jedi Master Quinlan Voss alongside Dooku's former acolyte, Asajj Ventress in a failed effort to assassinate the CIS head of state.]] The Confederacy would attempt to commit a [[Atrocity on Mahranee|mass genocide]] on the people of [[Mahran]] under orders from Count Dooku. [[File:Maul_Guest_of_the_Spire.png|thumb|right|250px|Darth Sidous would have Dooku imprison the renegade Sith Lord Maul at a CIS prison on Stygeon Prime, though Maul would escape with the aide of his allies in Death Watch.]] Darth Sidious had brought [[Maul]] to the Spire, a prison fortress controlled by the Confederacy of Independent Systems on [[Stygeon Prime]]. Before his arrest, Helgait revealed his Separatist loyalties, heralding the late Count Dooku as a visionary who was struck down in his prime. ==Organization== ===Government=== {{Quote|In accordance with the Bylaws of Independent Systems, a voice vote is required.|Dooku|}} [[File:Sidious_Dooku_Talk_2.png|thumb|left|300px|Dooku acted as Head of State of the CIS, but, in secret, was following the plans laid out by his Sith Master]] A union of independent governments and thousands of star systems, the Confederacy of Independent Systems was a confederate government organized and directed by former Jedi Master, Count Dooku, who served as the government's Head of State throughout much of the Confederacy's duration. Acting through the [[Bylaws of Independent Systems]], an established constitution that vested capabilities to the Confederacy's parliament, Dooku operated as an officiator within the legislature for congressional procedures. In theory,{{Databank|url=confederacy-of-independent-systems-history-gallery|title=Confederacy of Independent Systems History Gallery}} {{C|Slide 8}} the CIS was thus a democracy with Dooku simply as its executive figure and senatorial leader. In practice, however, Dooku secretly held great power over the state and was granted even greater authority over it as the Clone Wars dragged on. He manipulated its senate and the overall state to meet the ends of the Sith. Instead of actually answering to the will of the people, Dooku answered only to Sidious, who, as Dooku's Sith Master, alone could order the count. To meet his ends, Dooku manipulated the senate. Disparagingly referred to as "the Separatists" by those within the Galactic Republic, the Confederacy's ideological beliefs centered around minimal taxation and trade regulations, as it provided its member systems with an increase in control over their territories. Furthermore, the confederate government also offered assurances to its allies of a smaller and less centralized government, as well as freedom for local governments in order to privately maintain their internal affairs, while also offering egalitarian representation for governments that were left isolated within the galaxy's Rim regions from the Core Worlds and Republic Senate. [[File:TheAyesHaveIt-HOBS.png|thumb|right|300px|The Separatist Senate on Raxus was overseen by Dooku and filled by representatives of Separatist member worlds.]] Although its system of government appealed to multiple intellectuals and self-styled "free-thinkers," those of whom were inhabitants of the regions beyond the core, the Confederacy developed and came against two extensive issues. Firstly, as the Republic was militarily opposed to the secessionist movement, the CIS government's members worlds were required to relinquish control and resources to Dooku and the Executive Separatist Council in order to maintain their war effort. In practice, such control allowed Dooku to exert great power over the state.{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}} Furthermore, Dooku and his officers—such as General Grievous{{TCW|Massacre}}—were free to use the CIS military to commit massacres without answering to the senate. Dooku's political supporters were left unaware and believed in the image of a humanitarian leader who acted in their best interest. While covered up by Dooku, who would deny such practices if asked about them, the Confederacy also made use of torture. The second major problem faced by those who aligned with the Separatists came from the confederate government's laissez-faire stance in response to star systems' rights. Such a stance resulted in many Republic protections for workers, such as antislavery laws, autochthonous sentients' rights, and environmental exploitation and protection laws, being rendered ineffective. Unable to control their whole destiny and faced with a lack of those protections, localized resistances would emerge on numerous worlds out of dissatisfaction with the realities of separatism. One Separatist fighter, [[Soujen Vak-Nhalis]], found himself forced to admit that the Confederacy had made a terrible deal in signing itself over to corporate masters. To true Separatist believers like himself, such was done in the name that Separatist worlds might have a chance at self-determination by winning the war, with Vak-Nhalis hoping greatly that the deal would prove wise in the end.''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]'' [[File:SepCouncilUtapau-ROTS.png|thumb|300px|left|The corporate leaders of the Separatist Council on Utapau shortly after the Battle of Coruscant.]] With the Clone Wars, Dooku was provided wartime powers by the Separatist Parliament that undermined its democratic values. Indeed, despite the ideals of his Separatist supporters, the CIS in practice was a state that saw Dooku able to implement executive orders in regards to governmental decisions, resulting in the undermining of the democratic process and making the parliament ineffective. The position of Head of State also granted the state leader direct power over the Separatist Council, an executive advisory and administrative body formed from the leaders of the major galactic corporations that supported the Confederacy, such as Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray, Federation Settlement Officer Rune Haako, Techno Union Foreman Wat Tambor, Commerce Guild Presidente Shu Mai, InterGalactic Banking Clan Chairman San Hill, Corporate Alliance Magistrate Passel Argente, Senators [[Po Nudo]], [[Tikkes]] and [[Rogwa Wodrata]], and Geonosian Archduke Poggle the Lesser. The Separatist Council managed much of the Confederacy alongside Dooku. Furthermore, it was also responsible for the oversight of the government's daily operations and vital planetary occupations, as well as additional situations that were related to its efforts in the Clone Wars. Much like the Separatist Senate, however, the council would find itself virtually powerless under Dooku's leadership. Instead, the group was to follow the will of the count and his Sith Master.{{Databank|url=confederacy-of-independent-systems-history-gallery|title=Confederacy of Independent Systems History Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}} Still, while Dooku needed to keep his Sith loyalties a secret from the Separatist Senate, the Separatist Council was more than aware of the existence of Darth Sidious and the Sith Order's control over the Separatist state. However, the council did not know that the entire Separatist government was to be destroyed at war's end. Unlike Dooku, who acted for the betterment of the Sith Plan, council members worked in the name of the Confederacy or for their own profit in the case of corporate members like Gunray{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}} and Tambor.{{TCW|On the Wings of Keeradaks}} In the end, the Separatist Council was another group that was manipulated by the Sith and sacrificed for Sidious's greater goals. [[File:Grievous-speaks-to-Sidious.png|thumb|right|300px|Grievous succeeded Dooku as the Head of State but remained subservient to Darth Sidious.]] Following Dooku's death in the Confederacy's assault on the Republic capital world of Coruscant, control over the confederate government, its military forces''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' and protection of the Separatist Council was vested to the cybernetic warlord General Grievous, who had served as the [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies]] throughout the war's duration. A position held for only several days after Dooku's death, Grievous was silenced not long after his appointment to Head of State, which thereby transferred overall control of the Confederacy to a demoralized Separatist Council. ===Politics=== {{Main|Separatist Senate}} {{Quote|I'm not sure there was a ''right'' side. I opposed the Separatist Confederacy because it chose violence when other paths remained. It seemed to me—it still seems to me—that its cruel tactics and disregard for life were inseparable from the greed that drove the Confederacy's corporate elite. I also acknowledge that many well-meaning people saw matters differently and opposed the Republic for good and moral reasons. I've come to wonder if the whole war was a sort of feint—half a misdirection on the part of those who desired an Empire. Palpatine and his cronies pushed and pushed until the fighting started. Count Dooku was a… The particulars don't matter. But by joining the war, all of us played into Palpatine's hands.|Bail Organa, to Soujen Vak-Nhalis|}} Headquartered on the Confederacy's capital world of Raxus Secundus, the Separatist Senate was a legislative body of senators that governed the confederate government, while also existing primarily for mutual defense and dispute mediation. Independent from the obsolete mandates and proprieties that bridle the Republic coupled with corruption, the parliament lightly directed the Confederacy under the supervision of [[Separatist Congress Leader]] and Speaker, Senator Bec Lawise. However, despite serving as the government's legislature, the Separatist Parliament was granted with minimal power in practice: despite the ideals of its members, the senate operated in practice only as an advisory body to Dooku and the Executive Separatist Council, which handled the government's funding and military-based matters. Even then, there were moments where the senate surprised Dooku. In such cases, such as Senator Mina Bonteri's proposed peace accord with the Republic, Dooku worked to undermine the actions of his own people. [[File:SeparatistSenate-HOBS.png|thumb|left|250px|The Separatist Senate was housed on Raxus.]] Separatist senators were all from worlds and systems who joined the Separatist cause, including ones that had once been members of the Galactic Senate that continued to represent their constituents in the Confederacy, and had involvement in public affairs. The senate was seated on the Confederate capital planet of Raxus Secundus. Many loyalists and senators of the Republic believed that the Separatist senators were no more than pawns to Dooku. Furthermore, the senators of the parliament as well as the citizens of the Confederacy were repeatedly shielded from front-line reports of brutal campaigns waged by the Separatist Droid Army by the various elements of the Separatist hierarchy. Representing the civilians of the Confederacy, the Separatist Parliament was responsible for coordinating the mutual defense and mediating disputes between its members. It delegated most of its authority on taxation and trade regulation to its member systems, in accordance with the decentralized ideology of the Confederacy. All the while, however, the vast majority of power in the Separatist government was claimed by the Executive Council and military, robbing the parliament of its potential to make change. There were many in the Separatist Senate who desired secession without war, yet they believed the Republic had failed to listen to their pleas and they had no other choice. While the worst of the Confederacy's war crimes were hidden from its populous, many senators were aware that certain "excesses" were undertaken by the military. Many in the senate opposed those "excesses" without knowing the extent of the problem. ===Defense=== {{Main|Confederacy military|Separatist Droid Army|Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|CIS Special Operations|Separatist Intelligence}} {{Quote|Our friends from the Trade Federation have pledged their support. And when their battle droids are combined with yours, we shall have an army greater than any in the galaxy. The Jedi will be overwhelmed. The Republic will agree to any demands we make.|Count Dooku to the Separatist leadership|}} [[File:Clone-War-battlefront.png|thumb|300x300px|General Grievous leads the Droid Army in battle.]] The various commercial entities who joined under the banner of the Confederacy of Independent Systems pledged their forces to the [[Confederacy military|military]], creating one sprawling group of droids as well as organic forces, and local warriors, and was often referred to as the Droid Army, and was headed by a Supreme Commander. These units were led by organic [[Separatist officer|officers]] as well as [[tactical droid]]s to lead ground and naval forces, which included of the [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|T-series tactical droid]]{{TCW|Jedi Crash}} and the more sophisticated super tactical droid.{{Databank|general-kalani|General Kalani}} The Confederacy's droid army was the largest droid ground force in history.{{HelmetCollectionCite|21|Databank A-Z}} The Separatist war effort was focused upon economics and volume, as exemplified by its deployment of mass-produced, expendable battle droids in overwhelming numbers.{{UnlimitedWeb|url=articles/behind-unlimited-designing-twilight|text=Behind Unlimited: Designing "Twilight"}} The droid army was composed from the Trade Federation's battle droids to the security forces maintained by the Commerce Guild, InterGalactic Banking Clan, and Corporate Alliance, which donated not only its new [[B2-series super battle droid]]s, but numerous foundries capable of producing thousands more droids for deployment as well as the [[OG-9 homing spider droid]]s were a common sight on many front lines, and [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer|tank droids]] and AATs provided heavy firepower.{{TCW|Water War}} while also consisting of local forces of the worlds under its control,[[Kanan 7|''Kanan'' 7]] who were of flesh and [[blood]], however, government officials downplay this and stated that they were volunteers and not like the Republic [[Cloning|cloned]] soldiers which had been pressed into service. [[File:Separatist-frigates-Ryloth.png|thumb|left|300px|Naval warships active as part of the Confederacy's fleet.]] Its [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval wing]] was originally made up of heavily armed [[bulk transport]]s from Separatist member corporations, but, as the Clone Wars continued, [[Pammant Docks]] and other Separatist allies built [[capital ship]]s to make a creditable fleet. These [[starship]]s were filled with a variety of [[starfighter]]s and crewed by B1 battle droids, within it fleet, it included the ''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser which had [[mega-ion cannon]]s that could disable the power systems of entire fleets, rendering them defenseless against the ship's massive array of [[laser]]s. ===Outside relations=== {{Quote|Say it aloud before this gathering—as representative for Chancellor Palpatine that ''you'' declare, without reservation, the Separatist state ''legitimate''.|Senator Voe Atell to delegations from the Galactic Republic during a rare [[Confederate–Republic peace conference|conference]] on Mandalore|}} When the Confederacy of Independent Systems was formed, it received limited galactic recognition from many other entities due to a lack of legitimacy from the Galactic Republic as a separate state, but they did receive secret support from several major galactic corporations. [[Intergalactic Association of Amalgamated Droid Builders]] was also aligned with the Confederacy, providing construction and service for the Separatists' Droid Army. On the surface, the Confederacy was not interested in "conquering" the Republic; instead, its supporters wanted a chance at self-determination and many were open to existing alongside the Republic after making the war too costly for the Republic to proceed or finding a form of peace with their rival government. While the Separatists believed the Republic may collapse under its own contradictions given time, the war was only a way to secure their own future. However, the true face of the Confederacy—expressed through its military wing and hidden from its general population{{SWE|characters|minabonteri|Mina Bonteri}}—sought the destruction of the Republic. [[File:BecLawiseLetsContinue-AFIN.png|thumb|right|274x274px|The representatives of the Republic and the Confederacy meeting on Mandalore in an effort to end the Clone Wars.]] The [[New Mandalorians]] government, stayed neutral during the pan-galaxy conflict, and decided to agree to allow Mandalore as neutral ground to host an historic [[Confederate–Republic peace conference|peace conference]] between representatives of the Republic and the Confederacy in an effort to end the Clone Wars, where the separatists sought full diplomatic recognition from the Republic, which it did not grant, a recurring issue since its birth as a separate state, but negotiations talks would result in failure. The Confederacy moved to [[Annexation of the Qiilura system|annex]] the [[Qiilura system]] during the Clone War.{{TCW|Mercy Mission (episode)}} Later, they entered into relations with the [[Grysk Hegemony]], a warlike species hailing from the [[Unknown Regions]] who had maintained surveillance on the Confederacy prior contact, they then decided to share information on [[cortosis]], which was resistant against lightsabers.''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]'' With the Confederacy keeping close ties with certain criminal groups and mercenaries,{{FFGXW2|set=Trident-class Assault Ship Expansion Pack|cardname=Lawless Pirates}} several groups of [[pirate]]s also signed terms with the Confederacy of Independent Systems to exclusively target the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, these were the [[Delmaasi pirates|Delmaasi]], [[Iridium Pirates|Iridium]], [[Nuro pirates|Nuro]], [[Red Fury Brotherhood]], [[Merson pirates|Merson]] and [[Nuala Marauders]] pirates, who were encouraged by Count Dooku to harass Republic supply lines. As a result of the Separatist alliance with such groups, their technology occasionally ended up in the possession of pirates or other such groups. ==Society and culture== {{Quote|I can only wonder what Count Dooku offered Vallt's new leadership. Perhaps he promised to tug this world a bit closer to your star."
"Trade, respect, fair representation in the Confederacy. All that we weren't receiving as a member of the Republic.|Galen Erso and [[Gruppe]]|}} [[File:SeparatistSenate3-HOBS.png|thumb|left|250px|The Confederacy of Independent Systems was primarily made up of [[alien]] and [[near-human]]s.]] The Confederacy of Independent Systems population consisted of several different non-[[human]] [[alien]] groups, as well as [[near-human]]s,''[[Star Wars: Aliens of the Galaxy]]'' this being reflected in both its military and political as it hierarchy was largely dominated by non-humans. All species were seeking for fair trade, respect, and better representation in the Confederacy. Despite its many alien supporters, humans could occupy high ranking roles within the Confederacy, such as its head of state, Count Dooku, being a [[Serennian]], as well as [[Onderonian]] King [[Sanjay Rash]] and senator Mina Bonteri. Having been ignored by the Republic, most of the [[Alvadorjian]] clans sided with the CIS on the promise that it could provide a future for their dwindling species. Separatist believers prided their politics off the idea that, while the Republic and its Supreme Chancellor had become pawns of corporate monopolies, the CIS was free to stand as a real democracy. While the CIS did business with major corporations, its members believed they were not ruled by these factions. However, in practice, the great power given to these corporate actors through their representation on the Executive Separatist Council and as the state's sponsors left the government at their mercy. As Soujen Vak-Nhalis was forced to admit, the corporations, at the end of the day, had become his masters. Vak-Nhalis defended the alliance with these self-interested corporate actors as a necessary evil—even if, by his own admission, the deal in practice had been horrible for Separatists like himself—because they uplifted and gave the Separatists who already wanted to leave the Republic the ability to fight. Continuing to fight despite the realities of life under these corporations, Separatists like Vak-Nhalis hoped they might, through victory, have a chance at self-determination. During the Battle of Mon Cala, the Separatists exploited tensions between the [[Mon Calamari]] and Quarren by backing the latter. Count Dooku also ordered the [[Slavery|enslavement]] of Mon Calamari prisoners and civilians.{{TCW|Gungan Attack}} Despite supporting the Quarren, Dooku made a secret agreement with the [[Karkarodon]] leader [[Riff Tamson]] to crown him the new King of Mon Cala. The Confederacy later committed genocide against the Mahran species and attacked their homeworld, killing many civilians and [[refugee]]s. In addition, the Confederacy also issued an order that all Mahrans were to be regarded as extremely hostile and killed on sight. [[File:Fighting_for_Your_Independence.png|thumb|right|250px|A Separatist propaganda poster named ''[[Fighting for Your Independence]]''.]] According to Dooku's propaganda, the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order were the victims of their own ambitions. He also alleged that the Supreme Chancellor was the pawn of corporate monopolies and that the Jedi had secretly created the Grand Army of the Republic to suppress the Confederacy's demands for reforms and equality. While the Republic's clone troopers were regarded as unwilling slaves who were regularly sent to their deaths, the Separatists sacrificed mainly droids. Dooku also claimed that the Confederacy's flesh and blood soldiers were willing participants who were fighting for freedom. Count Dooku was the main leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems who served as a unifying force in the Separatist State. Many Separatists viewed him as a single, seemingly invincible figurehead to rally around. Some observers like the Jedi Master Mace Windu believed that eliminating Dooku would lead to the disintegration of the Separatist movement. To boost morale, Dooku traveled to several worlds including Raxus where he gave rousing speeches defending the Confederacy's cause and war effort. Wherever he traveled, Dooku was greeted by large crowds. Unaware of atrocities like the Attack on Mahranee or General Grievous's campaigns,{{SWE|characters|minabonteri|Mina Bonteri}} Dooku was respected enough within the Confederacy to be conferred with awards like the [[Raxian Humanitarian Award]]. ==Infrastructure== {{Quote|Yes, Count Dooku succeeded in using the HoloNet for Separatist propaganda purposes, but Republic forces were quick to shut down those Shadowfeeds.|[[Vice Admiral]] [[Dodd Rancit]] to [[Harus Ison]], regarding Dooku's Shadowfeeds during the Clone Wars|}} The Separatist State gained a vast transportation network as systems and sectors broke away from the Republic during the Separatist Crisis which served as means of both civilian and military transport to support its objectives. This included several major hyperspace lanes—which were considered trans-galactic highways—with their knowledge and existence dating back to well before the Galactic Republic. Their control was vital for maintaining an effective means of defense and security during the Clone Wars. The Confederacy needed to throw the majority of its resources into the war against the Republic. For that reason, the CIS had no time to try and discover new hyperspace routes by charting and mapping them out.{{InsiderCite|228|A Certain Point of View}} The Confederacy made use of the unauthorized [[HoloNet|holofeed]] network known as the [[Shadowfeed]]s to spread [[propaganda]] into Republic Space on the order of Count Dooku and to provide news and entertainment to its own citizens. Shadowfeeds were created through sabotage of legitimate HoloNet networks and established as their own network by the CIS. While [[Republic Intelligence]] was able to shut down many of these Shadowfeeds quickly, which eventually led to the creation of the [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic]], the network itself managed to survive and even persisted into the Imperial Era, enabling the usage of Shadowfeeds among surviving Separatists, other anti-Imperial actors,''[[Sabine My Rebel Sketchbook]]'' and criminal elements.[[Crimson Reign 1|''Crimson Reign'' 1]] The governor of the planet Eriadu, Wilhuff Tarkin, was responsible for frustrating Dooku by providing counterintelligence to shut down many of his Shadowfeeds during the Clone Wars. "[[The Factory]]" was a media outlet that provided propaganda content for the Shadowfeeds ranging from entertainment to creditable takedowns of Republic personnel. ==Astrography== ===Expansion and growth=== {{Quote|As I explained to you earlier, I am ''quite'' convinced that ten thousand ''more'' systems will rally to our cause.|Dooku, to the Separatist Council||audio=Dooku-Rally-AOTC.flac}} The Confederacy of Independent Systems numbered at several thousand [[star system]]s, that had left the [[Galactic Republic]] at the [[Separatist Crisis|start]] of the [[Clone Wars]], which were [[planet]]s primarily from the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner]] to [[Outer Rim Territories]], including the [[capital]] world of [[Raxus Secundus]], among others,{{Databank|raxus|Raxus}} such as [[Geonosis]],{{Rebels|Ghosts of Geonosis}} and [[Mustafar]].{{Databank|mustafar|Mustafar}} The spice-producing world of [[Nooroyo]] fell within Separatist space during the Clone Wars. The [[Deep Core]] planet [[Empress Teta]] also joined the Confederacy.''[[Nexus of Power]]'' Several neutral and unaligned worlds also were annexed by the Confederacy as the war dragged on, [[Battle of Dathomir|such]] as [[Dathomir]],{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}} and [[Florrum]].{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}} As noticed by Ahsoka Tano, populations on worlds occupied by the Separatist Alliance would at first closely follow every new rule put in place. However, they also made sure to see what reaction occurred when these directives were violated. Afterward, the local population would begin to push back against the occupiers, doing an extreme pushback if the Separatists were violent in their reaction. ===Falling back and wars end=== The Confederacy was pushed back to the spiral arms of the galaxy during the [[Outer Rim Sieges]] in the third and final [[Standard year|year]] as the Republic continued to keep the pressure in these territories,''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' continuing to take place until the final [[Standard day|days]] of the Clone Wars. ==Behind the scenes== ===Development=== The Confederacy of Independent Systems first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. Early in production of ''Attack of the Clones'', the various commerce guilds were to all employ the same type of battle droids that were used by the Trade Federation, albeit with different color schemes to differentiate allegiance, but it was later decided that having each guild have their own wholly unique droids would provide visual diversity.{{DB|droid|dwarfspiderdroid|dwarf spider droid}} ===Historical comparisons and analysis=== The book ''[[Star Wars and History]]'' compared the establishment of the "Separatist Confederacy" and its declaration of civil war to the [[Wikipedia:Confederate States of America|Confederate States of America]] seen in American history. The book suggests that the election of new leaders, Palpatine in the case of the Republic and [[Wikipedia:Abraham Lincoln|Abraham Lincoln]] in the case of the American government, were the spark that created the respective separatist crises. The authors then note they do not seek to compare Lincoln to the fictional villain that is Palpatine, instead raising the connection to claim a change in upper leadership helped lead to war in both cases.''[[Star Wars and History]]'' Author [[Jason Fry]] also pulled from the American Civil War when crafting lore about the Republic harnessing its industrial power for the war against the Confederacy, taking the idea from the Union's industrial and manpower advantage over the CSA.{{Twitter|jasoncfry|status/1755689246348726636|[[Jason Fry]]|quote=It is indeed.
